newsitem.title: USA: U.S. sweet crude grades bump higher, outrights dip.
newsitem.headline: U.S. sweet crude grades bump higher, outrights dip.

text.p: U.S. sweet crude barrels narrowed their discount to the outright price of crude on Friday, bumped higher by a narrowing WTI-Brent spread and some firmer numbers for dated Brent.
Light Louisiana Sweet/St. James traded at only a 2 cents discount to June West Texas Intermediate/Cushing, 5 cts stronger than early morning deals, traders said.
"With the Brent-WTI moving into $1.60, and dated around 25 cts off, the LLS found some strength," said a Texas trader.
June WTI/Cushing was around 10 cents lower at $19.75-85 a barrel, roughly 5 cts weaker than second month July barrels.
